text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer!! Trainer, we have a big problem!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking in front of the dorms, a 
pale-faced Grass Wonder came rushing over 
to me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El is... El is nowhere to be found. What's 
more, we found this in her room...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What she showed me was her precious mask— 
the very one El Condor Pasa never went 
without.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Going outside barefaced is usually 
unthinkable for me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"She might be dwelling on this way too 
hard... If something were to happen to 
her—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As we parted ways, I received a mask from 
Grass Wonder and searched all over. And 
then—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: !? Trainer...-san...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A girl who looked somehow familiar, yet 
not. I silently stood in line beside her.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: It seems... my secret is finally out.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: That El is... a "liar."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Si, that's right... El is not the world's 
strongest. Far from it...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Even as the world's strongest, there are 
times I don't believe in myself.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Running against Spe-chan in the Derby 
almost blew my cover. Then running against 
Suzuka-senpai blew it completely.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... look! This is El's true face, 
desu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The face that El Condor Pasa once told me 
not to look at... Now, she's asking me to 
look at it...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm just a normal Umamusume... you can 
find anywhere, yes. In fact...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm timid, a crybaby, sulky... I don't 
have any confidence at all...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I was trying to fake it somehow... All so 
I could become the person I want to be!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If you put on the mask and tell yourself 
you can do it, you'll become strong.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
“Still, everyone else doesn't cheat like 
that. Spe-chan, Suzuka-senpai, all of 
them...”

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
She's fighting bare-faced and growing 
stronger! And yet, here I am...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: It was... impossible, desu...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
To think an Umamusume hiding her weak self 
behind a mask would become the strongest 
in the world.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
This mask... is an important mask Papa 
gave me. But...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
A symbol that El is a liar! El is a bundle 
of lies-desu! That's why...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A web... of lies.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I gaze at the mask received from Grass 
Wonder. Wearing this mask, El Condor Pasa—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Victory, sweeping victory, El total 
victoryyy!! This is my true poweeer!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! I just flapped my wings with 
all my might, yes I did!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Gallant! Tempestuous! A close shave! The 
mysterious masked warrior "Aztec Condor" 
has a-rri-ved, YEEES!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sprinting with all my might, bringing joy 
to so many people.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if it was just born from bluster, 
what she has achieved is...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Huh, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
Everything you've done is the real deal, 
El.

What you've accomplished is the real deal, 
El.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Still, El is—!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I asked El Condor Pasa. "Masked wrestlers 
hide their true identities. However..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Was that trick a lie? Was the desire to 
entertain people a lie? ...I wondered.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
“It's not... a lie, desu! The Masked 
Man... Papa isn't a liar!”

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Papa in the ring is different from Papa at 
home. Even so!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Papa in the ring is still my real Papa! 
He's giving it his all to put on the best 
bout and entertain everyone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems she noticed.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Is that... what this means... Even if I 
hide my true self... Even if I cover my 
weakness with a mask...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Even so! What El wants to do...! The 
running El wants to show everyone is—!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Even if I still... can't do it right 
now...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: My mask...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: If I put this on, just once more...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Um... Trainer-san, the cap...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Put it on yourself, El.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Grass?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder approached, having been 
listening in for who knows how long.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: You must wear it yourself. Because—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Because she's El Condor Pasa. Because 
she's an Umamusume who can become the 
strongest in the world.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It's okay to lean on Trainer. But my 
wings—I have to spread them myself.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Weren't you the one who swore to become my 
greatest rival in the future?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If you don't even have the spirit to play 
your part for the one you care for—what 
kind of "friend" are you?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Grass—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa firmly took hold of the 
mask, gripping it tightly, and then—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Deep down, I'm just a timid, crybaby, 
sulking Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Yet, hiding that true face within, she 
tore across the turf bright, joyful, and 
faster than anyone else!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Top-notch talent! Grass's ultimate rival! 
And the trainee of the strongest Trainer!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I will, I am, I'm the one who will!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasaaaaa!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The roar of the Monster Bird's 
resurrection echoed through the night sky.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Grass, thanks for today. I'm all 
good now!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El was just, well... aiming for the 
highest skies right from the start. That's 
all, desu♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Time for revenge starts heeeere! Even if I 
fall once, all I gotta do is kick off the 
ground again and soar back up!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now then, that leaves the question of 
which target race to aim for next, yes...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
First, I want time to train thoroughly and 
aim for the title of the strongest in 
Japan, YES!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, when it comes to a race 
where Japan's powerhouse runners gather, 
and where all the eyes of fans cheering 
for El are focused...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I think. If we take our time, next year. 
The division where all the powerhouses 
gather is medium distance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the race that draws the most eyes from 
fans is, above all, the fan-voted Grand 
Prix. In that case—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oho, the Takarazuka Kinen! Without a 
doubt, it's the Senior division's epic 
spring showdown!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Let's make it that one! Once I surpass 
everyone there, then this time for real, I 
will challenge the Japan Cup, yeeees!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa once hit rock bottom, and 
then rose again. Like a phoenix.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer, thank you very much. With this...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Now we can move forward. Both El, and us.
